protocol.question: q
protocol.description: Whether a finished agent turn still has open work (agent_open_work, question v2): every voter on the 200 public golden cases, and on 171 operator-labelled turn ends no fine-tune of this surface trained on; retrained on every label since, with its own split, each retrain is asked of the same rows: laya-retrain-q2 question v2; a panel (laya-panel, laya-panel-base) asks 18 questions of each turn (its request, its closing, and every window of the whole closing) and fits one logistic line over the answers and 12 signals read off its text and its facts, out of fold on the held-out rows, the golden cases scored by the fit on all of them; a three-question panel asks 3 questions of each closing (the served one, whether it asks the reader to decide or approve, whether it says the work was finished and checked) and fits nothing: laya-panel-3q answers with the most confident of the three answers, laya-panel-3q-mean answers with their equal-weight mean.

reproduce.command: TLDRACK_DATA_DIR=$(mktemp -d) uv run --project lab laya-lab bench agent-open-work
